---
title: Potències observades i potències barrejades a Constantí
lang: ca
ref: figura-constanti-moran
format: gfm
execute-dir: project
execute: {echo: false, warning: false}
unaltraweb_compute:
  engine: python
  mode: figure
  inputs: [context/inputs/constanti-pedagogia.json, context/inputs/constanti-ortofoto-2025.png]
  outputs: [assets/img/generated/constanti-moran.svg]
---

```{python}
from pathlib import Path
import json
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D
root=Path.cwd()
while not (root/'.unaltraweb/computations.yml').exists():root=root.parent
d=json.loads((root/'context/inputs/constanti-pedagogia.json').read_text())
xy=np.array([p['xy'] for p in d['known_points']])/1000
observed=np.array([p['kw'] for p in d['known_points']]);shuffled=np.array(d['permutation']['values_kw'])
assert np.array_equal(np.sort(observed),np.sort(shuffled))
a,b,e,n=np.array(d['bounds'])/1000
image=plt.imread(root/'context/inputs/constanti-ortofoto-2025.png')
plt.rcParams.update({'font.family':'DejaVu Sans','font.size':18,'svg.fonttype':'none','svg.hashsalt':'constanti-moran'})
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(11.5,6.4))
fig.subplots_adjust(left=.025,right=.975,bottom=.13,top=.82,wspace=.06)
bins=[(0,5,'#65b5cf'),(5,25,'#2786ad'),(25,100,'#9c4f38'),(100,500,'#682b39')]
for ax,y,title in zip(axes,[observed,shuffled],['Potències publicades\nI de Moran = 0,192',f'Potències barrejades\nI = {d["permutation"]["I"]:.3f}'.replace('.',',')]):
    ax.imshow(image,extent=[a,e,b,n],alpha=.48)
    for lo,hi,c in bins:
        mask=(y>lo)&(y<=hi);ax.scatter(xy[mask,0],xy[mask,1],s=35,color=c,edgecolor='white',lw=.4,zorder=3)
    ax.set(xlim=(a,e),ylim=(b,n),aspect='equal',xticks=[],yticks=[],title=title)
    ax.plot([344,346],[4554.7,4554.7],color='#243e4b',lw=3);ax.text(345,4554.4,'2 km',ha='center',fontsize=17)
    for spine in ax.spines.values():spine.set_visible(False)
for name,location in [('industrial',(344.2,4562.2)),('nucli',(350.1,4555.5))]:
    r=d['examples'][name];pos=xy[r['index']]
    axes[0].annotate(f'{int(r["kw"])} kW',pos,xytext=location,arrowprops={'arrowstyle':'-','color':'#273d49'},
        bbox={'facecolor':'white','edgecolor':'none','alpha':.94,'pad':2},fontsize=18)
fig.legend(handles=[Line2D([],[],marker='o',ls='',color=c,label=f'{lo}-{hi} kW') for lo,hi,c in bins],
           loc='lower center',bbox_to_anchor=(.5,.015),ncol=4,frameon=False,fontsize=17)
fig.savefig(root/'assets/img/generated/constanti-moran.svg',facecolor='white',metadata={'Date':None});plt.close(fig)
```
